The #PremierSector enforces U.S. immigration laws anytime, anywhere.

Boots and hooves on the ground

The Premier Sector saddled up with folks from the U.S. Army’s 720th Military Police Battalion from Fort Cavazos, TX, which is here to help us carry out our mission of securing the border. We took a good old-fashioned horse ride to familiarize their staff with the #ElCentro area of responsibility and build bridges between our teams. @USBPChief 

#PremierSector #CBP #DHS #Army #ArmyStrong #HonorFirst

tweets.text:
Bakersfield has our attention…Again! 

An illegal alien who lives in #Bakersfield was arrested transporting 120 pounds of methamphetamine in her vehicle like she was running errands—only this errand was for transnational criminal organizations. One good sniff by our #K9 and BOOM, she was busted. 

She’s not only bad at narcotics smuggling, but we discovered she also has multiple DUI arrests, endangering everyone on the streets of Bakersfield. Guess she thought she was on the Fast and Felonious. 

Pro tip: If you’re going to go up against the #PremierSector, you better be comfortable with jail cells. 

#BorderPatrol #DHS #CBP #narcotics #meth #SniffedOut #BakersfieldFails
